 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests

NoLoadTestArray

Type: array

Array of NoLoadTest objects

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest

NoLoadTest

Type: object

No-load test results determine core admittance parameters. They include exciting current and core loss measurements from applying voltage to one winding. The excitation may be positive sequence or zero sequence. The test may be repeated at different voltages to measure saturation.

 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest TransformerTest.temperature

temperature

Type: object or number

Temperature at which the test is conducted.

 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndNoLoadTests NoLoadTest IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest

ShortCircuitTest

Type: object

Short-circuit test results determine mesh impedance parameters. They include load losses and leakage impedances. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence. There shall be at least one grounded winding.

 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root TransformerEndInfo.EnergisedEndShortCircuitTests ShortCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance

TransformerCoreAdmittance

The transformer core admittance. Used to specify the core admittance of a transformer in a manner that can be shared among power transformers.

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance Ravens.cimObjectType

cimObjectType

Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "TransformerCoreAdmittance"

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root TransformerEndInfo.CoreAdmittance IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance

TransformerMeshImpedanceArray

Type: array

Array of TransformerMeshImpedance objects

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance

TransformerMeshImpedance

Type: object

Transformer mesh impedance (Delta-model) between transformer ends.
The typical case is that this class describes the impedance between two transformer ends pair-wise, i.e. the cardinalities at both transformer end associations are 1. However, in cases where two or more transformer ends are modelled the cardinalities are larger than 1.

 No Additional Properties

cimObjectType

Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "TransformerMeshImpedance"

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance TransformerMeshImpedance IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root TransformerEndInfo.FromMeshImpedance

TransformerMeshImpedanceArray

Type: array

Array of TransformerMeshImpedance objects

Same definition as TransformerEndInfo.ToMeshImpedance

root TransformerEndInfo.TransformerStarImpedance

TransformerStarImpedance

Type: object

Transformer star impedance (Pi-model) that accurately reflects impedance for transformers with 2 or 3 windings. For transformers with 4 or more windings, TransformerMeshImpedance class shall be used.
For transmission networks use PowerTransformerEnd impedances (r, r0, x, x0, b, b0, g and g0).

 No Additional Properties

Resistance of the transformer end.

 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest

OpenCircuitTestArray

Type: array

Array of OpenCircuitTest objects

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest

OpenCircuitTest

Type: object

Open-circuit test results verify winding turn ratios and phase shifts. They include induced voltage and phase shift measurements on open-circuit windings, with voltage applied to the energised end. For three-phase windings, the excitation can be a positive sequence (the default) or a zero sequence.

 No Additional Properties

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root TransformerEndInfo.OpenEndOpenCircuitTest OpenCircuitTest IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root TransformerEndInfo.phaseAngleClock

phaseAngleClock

Type: integer

Winding phase angle where 360 degrees are represented with clock hours, so the valid values are {0, ..., 11}. For example, to express the second winding in code 'Dyn11', set attributes as follows: 'endNumber'=2, 'connectionKind' = Yn and 'phaseAngleClock' = 11.

root TransformerEndInfo.endNumber

endNumber

Type: integer

Number for this transformer end, corresponding to the end's order in the PowerTransformer.vectorGroup attribute. Highest voltage winding should be 1.

root IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.
